2014_spells.beast-bond.description: You establish a telepathic link with one beast you touch that is friendly to you or charmed by you. The spell fails if the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher. While the link lasts, the beast can telepathically communicate with you, and you can telepathically communicate with it, as long as you are within line of sight of each other.
2014_spells.beast-bond.effectSummary: Make a target charmed until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.beast-bond.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you establish a telepathic link with one beast you touch that is friendly to you or charmed by you. The spell fails if the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher; While the link lasts, the beast can telepathically communicate with you, and you can telepathically communicate with it, as long as you are within line of sight of each other. While the link lasts, the beast can telepathically communicate with you, and you can telepathically communicate with it, as long as you are within line of sight of each other; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
